column1: # Marine VHF channels, 156.000 to 162.025 MHz: ITU Radio Regulations Appendix 18, 47 CFR 80.371, Canadian practice, CEPT and Baltic national plans.
# regions: INT international, EUR Europe, BAL Baltic Sea, USA, CAN. use: V voice, D DSC (no voice), A AIS (no voice), L long range AIS (no voice).
# flags: d distress, c calling, s SAR, b bridge-to-bridge, p port operations / VTS, i intership, e public correspondence, m safety broadcasts, g government / Coast Guard, l low power.
# ship_mhz is where a ship transmits, coast_mhz where a coast station transmits
column2: equal = simplex. One row per region and designator (number + A/B suffix)
